message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-11-08 13:10 IST to 2026-11-09 13:10 IST (2026-11-08 07:40 to 2026-11-09 07:40 UTC)  
**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only, normalized and deduplicated.

No newly reported or newly updated vulnerability was verified as relevant to the monitored DLL software components during this 24-hour window.

### Findings

No qualifying findings.

Fresh advisory records discovered during the scan concerned unrelated products. Close-looking results were excluded where the affected package or product did not match the assigned DLL inventory, and no credible uncertain match remained for a "Possible matches needing review" section.

### MongoDB ecosystem sweep

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm and App Services, official integrations, and major officially maintained libraries and services. It also checked MongoDB-owned alerts and announcements plus public CVE, GitHub advisory, and CISA surfaces.

No MongoDB-related advisory or CVE was verified inside the scan window. The newest entries visible on the [official MongoDB alerts page](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) were dated 2026-11-03, and the [official driver release announcements](https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/c/announcements/driver-releases/110) showed no security release in the 8-9 November window.

**Closing:** No immediate review is recommended on the basis of a new, in-window vulnerability matching this DLL inventory. Continue routine monitoring; older vulnerabilities and general patch posture were outside this run's freshness scope.
